{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates('patient_id', keep='first')

# Check that biomarker_baseline has sentinel value -999.0
# Replace -999.0 with NaN for proper analysis
trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] = trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Check that biomarker_final has no sentinel values
# But we will check for any other anomalies
print("\nAfter replacing -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline:")
print("Missing values in biomarker_baseline:", trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum())

# Check the distribution of biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
print("\nbiomarker_baseline summary:")
print(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].describe())

print("\nbiomarker_final summary:")
print(trial_df['biomarker_final'].describe())

# Check for any negative values in biomarker_final
print("\nNegative values in biomarker_final:", (trial_df['biomarker_final'] < 0).sum())

# Check the difference between baseline and final
trial_df['biomarker_change'] = trial_df['biomarker_final'] - trial_df['biomarker_baseline']

print("\nbiomarker_change summary:")
print(trial_df['biomarker_change'].describe())

# Check the response rate by arm
print("\nResponse rate by arm:")
response_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
print(response_by_arm)

# Check the response rate by severity
print("\nResponse rate by severity:")
response_by_severity = trial_df.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean()
print(response_by_severity)

# Check the response rate by arm and severity
print("\nResponse rate by arm and severity:")
response_by_arm_severity = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean()
print(response_by_arm_severity)"}
